title: A Chain of Register Increments
statement: Let $A$ be a register program with $m$ registers and $d$ Boolean-oracle queries, let $y$ be its input, let $r$ be a register, and let $(3_i4)_{i\in\mathbb N}$ be a sequence of labels. Suppose that for every $i<k$, the instruction at label $3_i4$ increments register $r$ and proceeds to $3_{i+1}4$. If the initial register assignment $v$ has all values at most $B$ and $v(r)+k\le B$, then the program reaches $3_k4$ from $3_04$, with register $r$ increased by $k$ and all other registers unchanged; throughout the run, the prescribed safety condition holds and every register remains at most $B$.
